steps.message: Quantos chamados foram abertos em agosto de 2026 com o fornecedor 43.449.745/0001-45 - GB SERVICOS E REFRIGERACAO LTDA?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(supplier)) = LOWER(BTRIM('43.449.745/0001-45 - GB SERVICOS E REFRIGERACAO LTDA'));

SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(supplier)) = LOWER(BTRIM('43.449.745/0001-45 - GB SERVICOS E REFRIGERACAO LTDA')) ORDER BY ticket;
